description: Cancel a reply draft (sets status to cancelled; terminal). Works on queued, filled or failed drafts. Cancelling does not remove text the extension already put into a Reddit/Quora box in the user's browser, and a draft that is already done cannot be cancelled (409). Get ids from reply_drafts_list.

draftId.description: Draft id from reply_draft_create or reply_drafts_list.

name: reply_draft_cancel
